source.text:
100% this.

AI is magical for working with multilingual people in multilingual contexts.

I think and write in English, but I have to operate a lot at complex levels in Spanish, so I do the thinking and writing in English and have AI translate it.

As a writer, it pains me to see my own writing, when I read it back in Spanish, sound like AI.

But there's not much I can do about it, considering hiring a personal human translator for every little thing and who can write in a unique way in Spanish to mimic the native equivalent to my style is overwhelmingly unaffordable and too slow for the every day translation type work.
